caption: The drawing features five distinct, colored floral motifs arranged across a blank beige background. In the upper left, there is a pink flower with jagged petals outlined in dark red, attached to a curved green and brown stem with a yellow accent. To the right, a blue and white patterned flower with red spots has a jagged edge, attached to a green stem and brown foliage. Toward the upper right, a small simple white flower with yellow center and a green stem is visible, accompanied by the faint, handwritten text "ONE HALF OF ACTUAL SIZE." Below, a light brown flower with a wavy edge and covered in small red dots is attached to a curled brown and green stem. Adjacent and slightly below, a larger flower colored light purple with darker purple accents and dots, and a green center, is attached to a curved green stem with two green leaves. The objects are outlined and filled with colored lines, with no additional background or context other than the plain paper.
title: Crewel Embroidery
